Thomas Hardy, Tess of the d’Urbervilles.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/thomas-hardy/tess-of-the-durbervilles

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Thomas Hardy (author, writer of preface), died 1928.

First publication of the text used (SE colophon: 'Tess of the d’Urbervilles was published in 1891 by Thomas Hardy.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published before 1931 (SE colophon: 'Tess of the d’Urbervilles was published in 1891 by Thomas Hardy.'), so it is in the United States public domain. The edition's rights statement below says the same.
- Country of origin: the facts do not fix the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each of them has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die died in 1928, so the text entered the public domain in each of them on 1 January 1999.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
